rationale.risk-routing: Risk scores and tier thresholds determine which diffs are gated.
rationale.ai-review: LLM classifiers judge diffs' likelihood of causing severe faults.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Blocked developers review, modify, wait, or escalate to authorized managers.
rationale.oversight-explanation: The UI presents risk scores, reasons, feedback, and actionable options.
rationale.framework: Integrates scoring, tiered gates, explanations, and escalation into release workflows.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and evaluated multiple operational diff-risk models.
rationale.adopted: The production regression model operated at Meta for over nine months.
rationale.general-code: The mechanism assesses ordinary code diffs, not specifically AI-generated code.
rationale.metrics: Defines a diff risk score measuring quality failure likelihood.
rationale.risk-quality: Predicts and gates changes likely to cause severe reliability failures.
